camel_example: aliyun devops GET /organization/5ebbc0228123212b59xxxxx/serviceCredentials --region cn-hangzhou --serviceCredentialType 'username_password_（用户名密码类型）' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Retrieves a list of service credentials
name: ListServiceCredentials

parameters.help_en: The ID of the organization. You can get the organization ID from the URL of your organization in Alibaba Cloud DevOps, for example, `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如  https:// devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrgId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by the service credential type
parameters.name: service_credential_type
